roles.title: Who is responsible
roles.body: The organizer of an event decides how attendee data is used and is its controller; Yayatoh processes that data on the organizer’s behalf under a data processing agreement. Yayatoh is the controller for organizer and staff accounts, the public event marketplace and fraud prevention.

data.title: What we collect
data.body: Account details (name, email, password or sign-in codes); buyer and attendee details given at checkout (name, email, answers to the organizer’s questions); tickets, orders and check-ins; and technical data such as device and request logs. Card details are handled by Stripe and never reach Yayatoh.

purposes.title: Why we use it
purposes.body: To sell and deliver tickets, run check-in, send the messages you asked for, pay organizers, prevent fraud and abuse, keep the service secure, and meet legal duties. Marketing messages are only sent with your consent, and Global Privacy Control signals are honored.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.body: With the organizer of the event you book, with the sub-processors on our sub-processor list, and with authorities when the law requires it. We do not sell personal data.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Attendee details are removed 24 months after the event and check-in logs after 12 months. Payment records are kept for 7 years for tax and accounting. Checkouts that were never paid lose their personal details after 30 days.

security.title: How we protect it
security.body: Each organizer’s data is kept apart from every other organizer’s; sensitive answers and keys are encrypted; access by Yayatoh staff is limited and logged.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask for a copy of your data, to correct it, or to have it erased. For an event, ask its organizer, who can export or erase your data from their Yayatoh console; you can also write to us and we will pass the request on. Data the law requires us to keep (such as paid orders) is kept without details that identify you.
